import asyncio
import random
from datetime import date, datetime
from pathlib import Path


class Clock(datetime):
    pass


class Generator(random.Random):
    pass


class StoredPath(Path):
    pass


class Loop(asyncio.SelectorEventLoop):
    pass


Clock.now()
Clock(2026, 1, 1).timestamp()
Generator()
StoredPath("state").write_text("value")
Loop().time()
Loop().create_connection(None, "localhost", 80)
Loop().subprocess_exec(None, "true")


class TradingDate(date):
    pass


TradingDate.today()
TradingDate.fromtimestamp(0)
